meaning: Per-sense argument, IN-ACT_1 (formal act): both act premises read formally give no self-motion in the same respect. The formal mover premise faces causes that produce what they do not formally have.

strong_version_needed.STMT-MOVES-ONLY-AS-FORMALLY-IN-ACT: Each per-sense argument keeps both act premises in its one sense (IN-ACT_1). The weak IN-ACT_3 mover premise with IN-ACT_1 non-simultaneity is the mixed reading, which the TERM-SENSE-FORKS-2-CONTROLS model refutes.
